Chosen over the sheet's EndPrefecture/District cell (which erroneously repeats 'Mostorud') because the Arabic OtherLanguagePrimaryPipelineName 'خط غاز مستطرد-- التبين' unambiguously names El Tebbin (التبين) as the terminus, not Mostorod again. Confidence tier: low (single, unverified source; direction inferred from the Arabic name only, not corroborated elsewhere).
